relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: The intracerebroventricular (i.c.v) injection of bradykinin into the brains of rats has been shown to elevate anxiety-like behavior while diminishing social interaction [33].

key_findings: B2R ablation in TH cells transiently reduced body weight and lean mass in young mice without altering anxiety, motor coordination, glucose or monoamine levels.
